events.summary: Ixidor imagines ruin and Akroma makes it so.
events.quote: Ixidor had only to imagine their ruin and Akroma made it so.

events.summary: Volrath tells Karn he has failed Gerrard, the Legacy and himself.
events.quote: "You've failed Gerrard. You've failed the Legacy. You've failed yourself. I can do no more."

events.summary: Sisay sends the Predator crashing into Crovax's stronghold.
events.quote: I just sent the *Predator* crashing into his stronghold.

relations.note: Vows to continue until Phage is destroyed
relations.quote: Until the world unites in vengeful fury and Phage is destroyed, I will not stay my hand.

rejected.summary: Slain warriors of the Sakura-Tribe are buried with saplings.
rejected.quote: Slain warriors were buried with a tree sapling, so they would become a part of the forest after death.
